page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8a.16xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs powered by an AMD EPYC 9T24 processor with an x86_64 architecture running at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The system is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

This instance type does not include bundled local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external block storage options. It features a baseline network bandwidth of 20 Gbps and does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and balanced resource density offer a stable, predictable performance profile for enterprise workloads without the overhead of specialized hardware accelerators like GPUs.

Given its balanced compute-to-memory ratio and 64 dedicated vCPUs, the ecs.g8a.16xlarge is suited for general-purpose enterprise applications, web serving, application servers, and medium-scale databases that require consistent CPU performance and moderate memory capacity without local storage dependencies.
